name: Ciera
source:
A beautiful yet soft-spoken woman who didn't hesistate to show Elcia kindness upon their first meeting. She is Yuras' elder sister and shares a close bond with him, making Elcia somewhat envious of their tight-knit, familial relationship.

Her remarkable benevolence puts people around her at ease, giving her a mother-like quality. She seems to have a knack for healing, albeit her methods seems to be unknown.
